About

This app is a demo version of MMovies, designed to showcase its interface and features using built-in sample content. You can explore movies, TV series, news, search, and detailed information about titles, seasons, episodes, and actors. All content is provided for demonstration purposes only and may not reflect real or up-to-date information. The app works offline and does not require an internet connection, API keys, or an account. Some features, including login, profile management, and favorites, are unavailable in this demo version.

Terms and Conditions
MMovies is a free, non-commercial app built as a personal project. By using it, you agree to the following terms.
TMDB Attribution
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Content Ownership

All movie and TV show data, images, and related content displayed in this app are sourced from The Movie Database (TMDB) and belong to TMDB and its content providers. MMovies does not own, and makes no claim to, this content.
Guardian Attribution
The News section uses the Guardian Open Platform API to display movie and TV headlines. This content belongs to Guardian News & Media Limited and is not owned by MMovies.
Gemini Attribution
AI-powered Recommendations, when enabled with a user-supplied Gemini API key, are generated using Google\'s Gemini API. This feature is not active until a valid API key is provided.
Voice Search

Voice search is optional and uses your device\'s speech recognition service, which is provided by Google and subject to Google\'s own terms. It is only active while you are using the microphone button in Search, and only if you grant microphone permission.
Data Accuracy

Content is provided by TMDB \"as is.\" Neither TMDB nor the developer of this app guarantees that the information shown is accurate, complete, or up to date. Details may be missing, outdated, or incorrect.
No Warranty

MMovies is provided as-is and as-available, without warranty of any kind, express or implied. Use of this app is at your own risk. The developer is not liable for any damages or losses arising from your use of the app.
Non-Commercial Use
This app is not monetized and generates no revenue. It is a personal, non-commercial project and does not sell, sublicense, or redistribute TMDB, Guardian, or Gemini content or data.
Changes to These Terms
These terms may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy
MMovies is a free, non-commercial personal project. This policy explains what information the app handles and how.
Account Credentials

When you log in, your TMDB username and password are sent directly to TMDB\'s servers to create a session and are never stored or seen by anyone other than TMDB. You can also use the app as a guest without providing any credentials.
Locally Stored Data
The app stores your TMDB session identifier and account ID on your device to keep you signed in. This data stays on your device and is removed when you log out or clear the app\'s storage.
Voice Search

If you use voice search, the app asks for microphone permission and listens only while you have pressed the microphone button in Search. Your speech is processed by your device\'s speech recognition service (provided by Google), which may send the audio to Google\'s servers. MMovies does not record, store, or receive the audio; it only receives the recognized text and uses it as your search query. You can revoke the permission at any time in your device settings.
Third-Party Services

Movie and TV data, images, and account authentication are provided by The Movie Database (TMDB). News headlines are provided by the Guardian Open Platform. AI-powered recommendations, when enabled, are provided by Google\'s Gemini API using a key you supply. Use of these services is subject to each provider\'s own privacy policy.
No Analytics or Tracking
MMovies does not collect analytics, does not use advertising, and does not share any data with third parties beyond the requests needed for the app to function.
Children\'s Privacy
This app is not directed at children and does not knowingly collect information from children.
Changes to This Policy
This policy may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Stranded above a dying Earth, an astronaut intercepts a signal from a mission that vanished decades ago. With oxygen running low, she must choose between a desperate return home and a journey that could give humanity a second chance.

A missing musician draws a weary detective into the neon-lit streets of a city that never stops raining. As each clue points toward his own forgotten past, he discovers that someone is rewriting the truth—and his name is next.

A young mapmaker discovers a hidden gateway deep within a forbidden forest. To save her village from a spreading blight, she must cross into a forgotten kingdom where every path demands a memory in return.

Returning to a seaside town to sell her grandmother\'s flower shop, an ambitious architect meets a local gardener determined to keep it alive. Over one unexpected summer, their unlikely partnership forces them to reconsider what they want to build—and where they belong.

A rescue diver searching for a missing research crew follows a mysterious light into an uncharted ocean trench. When voices begin coming through a disconnected radio, she realizes the greatest danger may be what she brings back to the surface.

An aging rider agrees to escort a runaway witness across a drought-stricken frontier. Pursued by a ruthless landowner and an approaching storm, the pair must reach a distant courthouse before the truth is buried with the town they left behind.

A tiny cloud who cannot make rain sets off to find a place in the sky. When a floating village begins to drift toward a scorching desert, this unlikely hero discovers that even the smallest cloud can make a big difference.

Years after abandoning the stage, a gifted pianist receives an unfinished composition from his estranged mentor. Preparing it for one final concert brings him face to face with an old betrayal—and the possibility of forgiveness.

At an isolated Arctic station, a radio engineer receives a distress call in her own voice, dated three days in the future. With a blizzard cutting off escape, she must uncover what happened to the previous crew before their fate becomes hers.

A bicycle courier witnesses a political assassination and escapes with the only recording of the killer. Hunted across the city\'s rooftops, she has until sunrise to deliver the evidence to a journalist before a coordinated blackout erases it forever.

Returning to her coastal hometown, a detective investigates a fisherman\'s disappearance and uncovers a network of secrets tying the harbor\'s most respected families together. Each new case brings her closer to the truth about her own mother\'s unsolved death.

After Earth falls silent, the settlers of a remote planetary colony must build a future without supplies or instructions from home. As rival factions struggle for control, a survey team discovers evidence that their new world was never uninhabited.

An unexpected queen inherits a fractured kingdom and a court determined to control her. To protect her family\'s future, she must navigate shifting alliances, forbidden loyalties, and a succession secret that could end her dynasty.

Four strangers discover they have all signed a lease for the same apartment. Unable to afford moving out, they turn a housing disaster into an unconventional shared home, tackling awkward romances, chaotic jobs, and a landlord who is mysteriously never available.

At a school hidden within an ancient forest, three newcomers discover that their magic is connected to the trees keeping the academy alive. Between lessons and rivalries, they investigate a spreading darkness that the teachers refuse to acknowledge.

A cybersecurity analyst finds a hidden program predicting crimes before they happen. Working with a disgraced investigator, she traces its victims across the city while trying to determine whether the system is preventing violence or quietly arranging it.

The night team at an underfunded city hospital handles emergencies that never make the morning headlines. As two doctors rebuild their careers, the staff must balance difficult medical decisions, personal loyalties, and the growing threat of their department\'s closure.

After inheriting a struggling mountain guide service, two estranged siblings reunite to keep their father\'s business alive. Rescue missions and unpredictable visitors test their fragile partnership, while a trail journal leads them toward a long-buried family mystery.

A restless waitress takes over her family\'s roadside diner, determined to give it a fresh start. Between eccentric regulars, passing strangers, and late-night confessions, she discovers that keeping the doors open means becoming the unlikely heart of her small town.

A reclusive clockmaker discovers that certain broken timepieces preserve the final moments of their owners. With the help of a skeptical journalist, he uses them to investigate unexplained deaths, unaware that each repair is changing his own past.
Fictional demo article — all productions, events, and reporting described here are mock content.
First Look: Last Orbit Reveals Its Lunar Set
The fictional science-fiction drama combines a practical moon surface with a vast illuminated backdrop.

The production team behind Last Orbit has unveiled its first look at the lunar landscape built for the film. Textured ground panels, sculpted rock formations, and a glowing planetary backdrop give the cast a physical environment to explore during filming.

The story follows an astronaut who intercepts a signal from a long-lost mission while stranded above Earth. For the scenes outside her spacecraft, the crew designed lighting that shifts from harsh sunlight to the cold blue glow of the planet below.

The next stage of production will focus on spacecraft interiors and close-up character moments. The team hopes the contrast between enormous landscapes and confined rooms will underline the astronaut's isolation.
Harbor Secrets Returns to the Coast for Season Two
A new disappearance brings the detective drama back to its fog-covered hometown.

Harbor Secrets is returning to the waterfront with a second season centered on the discovery of an abandoned fishing boat. The investigation draws the town's detective into a dispute that has divided local families for generations.

The production is using working docks, weathered warehouses, and a remote lighthouse to expand the series' coastal setting. Early-morning filming captures the low fog that has become part of the show's visual identity.

Alongside the new case, the season will continue the detective's search for answers about her mother's death. Familiar residents will return, joined by a harbor inspector whose arrival unsettles the town's carefully maintained alliances.
Inside the Miniature Worlds of Little Cloud
Handcrafted models helped shape the animated adventure\'s floating village.

Before the floating village in Little Cloud became an animated world, it existed as a collection of tiny houses on a studio workbench. Artists built miniature streets, gardens, and bridges to explore how the community might live above the clouds.

The models gave the animation team a reference for lighting, textures, and the playful scale of the setting. Small details, including rooftop rain collectors and wind-powered lifts, helped suggest a world with its own everyday routines.

The film follows a tiny cloud who struggles to make rain but discovers a different way to help. The designers wanted the village to feel welcoming enough that audiences would understand why this unlikely hero is determined to protect it.
Independent Voices Take Center Stage at the Silver Bay Festival
The fictional festival opens with debut features, intimate documentaries, and filmmaker conversations.

The Silver Bay Film Festival opened its latest edition with a program focused on first-time directors and stories rooted in local communities. Filmmakers gathered outside the restored waterfront cinema before an evening screening and audience discussion.

This year's fictional lineup ranges from a family drama set in a mountain village to a documentary about a disappearing neighborhood theater. Short-film sessions will pair emerging directors with experienced editors and producers for conversations about their craft.

Organizers have also added relaxed daytime screenings and practical workshops on sound, lighting, and low-budget production. The aim is to make the festival a place where audiences can discover new films and understand how they are made.
The Final Note Records Its Score with a Live Orchestra
Piano-led themes give the fictional music drama an intimate emotional voice.

Recording has begun on the score for The Final Note, with a grand piano and chamber orchestra sharing the same studio floor. The arrangement allows the musicians to respond to one another during the quieter passages that anchor the film.

The drama follows a former concert pianist preparing an unfinished composition left by an estranged mentor. Its music develops alongside the character, beginning with spare piano phrases before gradually introducing strings and woodwinds.

Rather than filling every scene with music, the sound team is leaving room for pauses, breathing, and the natural noises of performance. The final concert sequence will bring those small details together in a longer uninterrupted musical passage.
Why Filmmakers Are Returning to Practical Creature Effects
A fictional workshop shows how physical models and digital finishing can work together.

Inside a busy creature workshop, artists are building an alien character one layer at a time. A lightweight internal frame supports sculpted features, while flexible silicone gives the face subtle movement under studio lighting.

Physical creatures give actors something visible to react to and help camera teams judge shadows and scale on set. Digital effects can then remove supports, refine movement, or extend the performance without replacing every part of the model.

The approach requires close cooperation between sculptors, puppeteers, performers, and visual-effects artists. For this fictional production, the goal is a creature whose small gestures feel believable before any final polish is added.
Apartment 404 Opens the Door to a New Ensemble Comedy
A shared apartment becomes the setting for a comedy about strangers learning to live together.

The cast of Apartment 404 has begun rehearsals on a brightly colored apartment set designed to keep its four leads constantly crossing paths. A narrow kitchen, crowded entryway, and unreliable sliding door provide plenty of opportunities for comic interruptions.

The series follows four strangers who discover that they have all rented the same apartment. With moving out beyond their budgets, they negotiate shared shelves, conflicting schedules, and the problem of finding even a few minutes alone.

Rehearsals are helping the ensemble develop familiar habits and running jokes before filming begins. The production team wants the apartment to feel increasingly lived-in as the characters turn an awkward arrangement into a makeshift household.
Inside the Lab Bringing Classic Cinema Back to Life
A fictional restoration team balances image cleanup with the texture of the original film.

A film restoration begins long before an image reaches a computer screen. At the fictional Silver Frame Archive, technicians inspect each reel for damage, document its condition, and prepare the material for careful scanning.

Once digitized, the footage can be checked for dust, scratches, unstable frames, and changes in color. Reference prints and production notes help the team judge which differences come from aging and which were part of the original photography.

The aim is not to make every older film look newly shot. Grain, contrast, and other visual characteristics are treated as part of the work's identity, allowing a restored screening to retain the texture that audiences would associate with its era.
How Run at Dawn Built Its Rooftop Chase
Rehearsals, controlled sets, and camera placement shape the fictional thriller\'s action.

The rooftop chase in Run at Dawn begins with slow, carefully planned rehearsals. Performers practice their movements on controlled platforms while the stunt team checks harnesses, landing areas, and the camera's position.

The film follows a courier trying to deliver evidence across a city before sunrise. To create the impression of a continuous escape, the production combines purpose-built rooftop sections with skyline footage and tightly matched shots.

The sequence is designed around the character's exhaustion as much as the spectacle. Short pauses, difficult choices, and changes of direction help keep the audience connected to her journey while the crew builds the action one shot at a time.
Building Starlight Diner: A Set Full of Small-Town Stories
The fictional series uses everyday objects to give its central gathering place a history.

The diner at the center of Starlight Diner is being built to look as though generations of customers have already passed through its doors. Turquoise booths, mismatched coffee cups, and a carefully worn counter give the set a familiar, welcoming atmosphere.

Designers have assigned small details to recurring characters, from a regular customer's preferred booth to a shelf of souvenirs left by travelers. These objects provide background clues without interrupting the conversations that drive the series.

Lighting changes the space throughout each episode, moving from bright breakfast service to quiet late-night reflections. As the new owner tries to keep the business running, the diner itself will become a record of the community growing around her.

A missing fisherman draws a returning detective into a smuggling investigation. As the harbor families close ranks, evidence connects the case to her mother\'s death and forces her to choose whom she can trust.
Homecoming
Returning to the harbor, the detective finds an abandoned fishing boat carrying a clue to her mother\'s last investigation.
Low Tide
A storm exposes a locked chest beneath the old pier, drawing two rival families into the search.
The Lighthouse Keeper
The retired lighthouse keeper recalls a signal sent on the night the fisherman vanished.
Borrowed Names
Shipping records reveal that someone has been using the missing man\'s identity to move mysterious cargo.
Deep Water
A diver retrieves a damaged camera, but its final recording raises doubts about the detective\'s closest ally.
The Family Table
An invitation to a wealthy family\'s dinner gives the detective a chance to question their carefully rehearsed story.
Storm Warning
With the harbor sealed by severe weather, a frightened witness seeks shelter in the police station.
The Unsent Letter
A letter hidden among her mother\'s belongings reveals an agreement that could explain the original cover-up.
Last Departure
The team follows a final shipment while the detective confronts the person who betrayed her mother.
Daybreak
A dawn operation exposes the harbor conspiracy, leaving the detective to decide whether her hometown can become home again.

When contact with Earth disappears, Colony Nine faces failing supplies and a bitter struggle over leadership. A survey team\'s discovery beneath the desert offers hope, but awakening an ancient system may put the settlement at risk.
The Silent Channel
The colony\'s last transmission from Earth cuts off just as a supply ship fails to arrive.
Ration Day
New water restrictions divide the settlement as engineers discover a leak beyond the safe perimeter.
Beyond the Beacons
A survey team follows an unexplained energy reading past the colony\'s marked routes.
Buried Geometry
The explorers uncover a geometric doorway that no human expedition could have built.
A Different Flag
A breakaway group occupies the greenhouse, forcing the council to negotiate over the colony\'s food supply.
The Dust Season
A planet-wide storm separates the survey team from home and tests a new commander\'s authority.
Echoes Below
Signals from an underground chamber suggest the ancient structure is responding to human voices.
Power Exchange
An experiment restores electricity to the colony while draining energy from an unexpected source.
The Long Night
With the settlement threatened by a spreading failure, rival factions must work together to keep the domes sealed.
First Light
The colonists reach an uneasy agreement with the ancient system and send a new message into space.

A reluctant queen takes the throne as famine and rival claims threaten her realm. While learning to rule a divided court, she uncovers a hidden succession pact and must risk her crown to prevent a civil war.
The Empty Throne
An unexpected death brings the queen to court, where her coronation conceals a struggle over who will truly govern.
A Crown of Debts
The treasury\'s missing funds force the queen to choose between a royal celebration and relief for hungry villages.
The Northern Envoy
A visiting envoy offers grain in exchange for a marriage alliance that divides the royal household.
Behind the Tapestry
A servant overhears a secret meeting and brings the queen evidence of a rival succession claim.
Winter\'s Price
The queen leaves the palace to inspect the northern roads, discovering why promised supplies have not arrived.
The Masked Feast
During a masked banquet, an unlikely ally warns the queen that her closest adviser is bargaining with her enemies.
Blood and Ink
An old legal pact reveals a family secret that could invalidate the queen\'s right to rule.
The Broken Oath
When a border commander refuses her orders, the queen must decide whether loyalty can be bought or earned.
Before the Gates
Rival forces approach the capital as the court prepares to abandon the queen.
The People\'s Crown
A public reckoning over the succession gives the queen a chance to unite the realm on new terms.

Four strangers reluctantly share the apartment they were each promised. Between household rules, rent troubles and an elusive landlord, their temporary arrangement grows into a friendship they are not ready to give up.
Four Sets of Keys
Four new tenants arrive on moving day and discover that their individual leases describe the same apartment.
The Fridge Treaty
A disagreement over groceries leads to strict household rules that nobody can follow for a full day.
Working From Chaos
Three job interviews and a repair visit collide when everyone needs the living room at once.
Plus One
A dinner date turns into an accidental group event when the roommates refuse to leave the apartment.
The Noise Upstairs
The group investigates a strange nightly noise and unexpectedly joins a neighbor\'s amateur dance rehearsal.
Rent Week
A delayed paycheck inspires a weekend sale that nearly parts the household from its most valuable possession.
Emergency Contact
A minor mishap forces the tenants to admit how little they know about one another.
The Perfect Tenant
A surprise inspection sends the household into a frantic effort to pretend that only one person lives there.
No Forwarding Address
The landlord finally responds, but the message suggests that the building may soon be sold.
Room for Everyone
The tenants rally their neighbors and discover that keeping their home requires a plan bigger than saving rent.

Three newcomers learn that their unusual magic is tied to the ancient forest supporting their school. As the trees weaken and teachers conceal the cause, the students must uncover a forgotten promise before the academy loses its home.
Through the Roots
Three new students arrive at the hidden academy and hear a voice that nobody else seems to notice.
The First Spark
A simple classroom exercise reveals that the newcomers\' powers respond to one another.
Leaves of Glass
Transparent leaves appear across the grounds, leading the students to a closed greenhouse.
The Forbidden Path
Following a trail beyond the school boundary, the students discover a grove missing from every map.
Lessons in Listening
An eccentric groundskeeper teaches the newcomers how to understand the warnings carried through the roots.
The Lantern Trial
A nighttime school contest becomes a rescue mission when a rival student disappears.
Under the Library
A hidden room beneath the library preserves records of an agreement between the academy and the forest.
The Withering
As branches begin to collapse around the school, the teachers struggle to contain a spreading magical illness.
Three Promises
The students must confront their private fears before they can renew the bond protecting the trees.
The Living School
A journey into the oldest roots reveals how the academy can survive without draining the forest.

A cybersecurity analyst discovers a system that predicts violent crimes. With a disgraced investigator, she follows its warnings until the evidence suggests the program is shaping events, forcing them to expose the people behind it.
The Prediction
An unexplained alert names a crime scene before the police receive a call.
False Positive
A warning about an ordinary commuter leads the analyst to question what the system considers a threat.
Blind Spot
The pair discovers a city block missing from the surveillance network and finds someone living outside its reach.
Access Denied
An attempt to trace the software\'s owner locks the analyst out of her own workplace.
Human Error
A former developer reveals that the program\'s most accurate predictions came from manually altered data.
The Test Group
Files connect several apparent strangers to an abandoned behavioral research project.
Ghost Account
The analyst follows payments from a nonexistent employee to a private control center.
Redirection
A fabricated warning draws the investigators away from a witness who knows how the predictions are staged.
The Last Backup
With their evidence scheduled for deletion, the pair enters the control center to secure a final copy.
Open Source
The analyst broadcasts the evidence while the investigator tries to prevent one last manufactured crime.

The night staff of a struggling hospital faces rising demand and the threat of closure. Two doctors rebuilding their careers learn to rely on the team while gathering evidence that their department is essential to the city.
After Midnight
Two newly assigned doctors begin their first night together as an unexpected surge fills the waiting room.
The Spare Bed
A shortage of beds forces the team to coordinate care while a familiar visitor refuses to leave.
Quiet Hours
A brief lull gives the staff time to reflect until a power fault disrupts routine care.
Second Opinions
A disagreement between the new doctors exposes the professional setbacks they have both been hiding.
The Long Wait
A crowded waiting room tests the team\'s patience while a nurse advocates for an overlooked patient.
Paper Walls
News of a funding review spreads through the department just as staff are asked to work extra hours.
Family Visiting
An unexpected family visit complicates a doctor\'s shift and challenges the boundary between work and home.
No Easy Answers
A difficult night forces the staff to defend a decision made with limited information.
On the Record
The department prepares to present its case to hospital leadership while managing a citywide emergency.
Morning Handover
After a demanding final shift before the review, the team learns whether its work has secured the department\'s future.

Two estranged siblings inherit their father\'s struggling guide service. As they rebuild trust through difficult mountain rescues, an old trail journal leads them toward a hidden chapter of his life and a choice about their shared future.
The Inheritance
The siblings return to their father\'s lodge and reluctantly accept their first booking together.
Wrong Turn
A lost visitor forces the siblings onto a route their father had marked as unsafe.
The Marked Page
An annotation in an old journal points to a campsite connected to their father\'s final season.
Thin Ice
An early cold snap turns a routine outing into a test of the siblings\' conflicting instincts.
Old Partners
A former colleague arrives with an offer to buy the business and a different version of their father\'s past.
Above the Clouds
A difficult high-altitude trek gives the siblings a rare chance to speak honestly.
Fireline
A wildfire warning forces the guides to lead visitors away from a threatened valley.
The Hidden Cabin
The journal leads to an isolated cabin holding letters their father never sent.
One More Climb
A missing climber draws the siblings toward the ridge at the center of the family mystery.
A Way Home
After the rescue, the siblings decide what to preserve of their father\'s legacy and what to build for themselves.

A young woman takes over her family\'s roadside diner and tries to save it from mounting debts. Through eccentric regulars and unexpected visitors, she discovers that a fresh start depends on the community she once hoped to leave.
Open Late
The new owner extends the diner\'s hours and discovers that the night crowd has its own unwritten rules.
The Usual
An unfamiliar breakfast order from a longtime regular reveals that change has reached more than the menu.
Table for Two
A pair of former sweethearts reunites at the diner, leaving the staff to navigate an awkward evening.
Off the Menu
An experimental dish divides the regulars while a visiting food writer arrives without warning.
Rain Check
A flooded road strands several travelers inside the diner for an unexpectedly revealing night.
The Spare Key
Finding an old key leads the owner to a storage room filled with memories of her parents\' early years.
Friday Night Lights
A community fundraiser promises much-needed income until a local event threatens to draw everyone away.
Passing Through
An old friend offers the owner a job elsewhere, reopening the question of whether she wants to stay.
Last Orders
A notice about the building\'s future pushes the staff and regulars to organize a final ambitious service.
A Place at the Counter
The town comes together to secure the diner\'s future, and the owner makes a decision about her own.

A clockmaker learns that broken watches preserve fragments of their owners\' final moments. A skeptical journalist helps investigate the deaths, but every repair changes a detail of his past and draws them toward a watch he cannot remember making.
The Stopped Watch
A watch brought in for repair shows the clockmaker a moment that seems to belong to its late owner.
A Minute Missing
A journalist helps trace the watch, discovering a gap in the official account of its owner\'s death.
The Glass Dial
An unusual clock reveals two conflicting memories of the same evening.
Borrowed Hours
After a repair, the clockmaker notices that a familiar photograph has changed.
The Collector
A private collector offers to buy every damaged watch in the workshop, raising questions about what he knows.
The Unwritten Story
The journalist finds her own unpublished notes describing events she does not remember witnessing.
Beneath the Tower
A trail of repair marks leads the pair into a sealed chamber below the town clock tower.
The Maker\'s Mark
A watch bearing the clockmaker\'s signature points to a commission missing from his memory.
One Last Repair
The clockmaker prepares to fix the mysterious watch despite evidence that it could erase their investigation.
When the Bells Return
The final memory reveals the cost of the repairs and gives the pair one chance to set their own history right.
